# Verexa Technologies

> AI automation, custom business software, and managed technology for businesses across the Greater Toronto Area.

Verexa Technologies is a Toronto-based technology partner. Verexa helps growing businesses automate repetitive work, build focused internal and customer-facing software, connect existing systems, and manage agreed applications, cloud environments, automations, access, and workplace technology.

## Primary services

- AI & Workflow Automation: process automation, document processing, email and CRM workflows, internal knowledge assistants, reporting, and integrations.
- Custom Business Software: internal dashboards, client portals, operations systems, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, and integrations.
- Managed Technology: application and automation management, cloud administration, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace support, backups, access administration, documentation, and vendor coordination within an agreed scope.

## Supporting capability

- Cloud & Infrastructure: application environments, migrations, deployments, databases, backups, access, recovery planning, performance, and cost reviews.
- Web development, mobile development, product design, and UI/UX are capabilities used within larger business-software projects.

## Focus industries

- Professional Services
- Real Estate & Property Management
- Construction & Trades

Verexa also works on carefully scoped projects for healthcare, dental, wellness, food, retail, and hospitality businesses.

## Working approach

Discover → Build → Integrate → Manage

Verexa does not claim 24/7 helpdesk or security-operations coverage unless it is explicitly included in a written engagement scope.
